body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Poitiers, France. It starts at Avenue René Monory.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Experience the fantastical world of Futuroscope, one of the world's best theme parks, and discover over 40 original immersive experiences and many unusual venues for all ages!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €62.94. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 430 ratings and 186 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
